properties.name: ML-DSA-87 (Module-Lattice-Based Digital Signature Algorithm)
properties.complexity_bounds: O(k * l * n log n) polynomial ring operations, n=256, k=8, l=7

properties.name: Number Theoretic Transform (NTT) for q=8380417
properties.complexity_bounds: Time: O(N log N) 32-bit modular multiplications; Space: O(N)
properties.ring_modulus: q = 8380417, primitive 512th root of unity w = 1753
properties.algorithm_variant: Cooley-Tukey butterfly with Barrett and Montgomery reductions

properties.microarchitectural_effect: Multiply packed signed 32-bit integers, expand to 64-bit results
Multiply packed signed 32-bit integers, accumulate into 64-bit vector elements

properties.alignment_requirement: 16-byte boundary for optimal vector memory loads (LDP/STP)
properties.volatile_status: V8-V15 lower 64 bits callee-saved, others caller-saved (AAPCS64)

properties.operation: Accelerates polynomial matrix-vector multiplication in Quotient Ring R_q for signing/verification

properties.vector_width: 4x 32-bit ring coefficients processed simultaneously per SIMD lane

properties.stage: Initial 32x32->64 bit polynomial coefficient multiplication in Barrett reduction
Accumulation phase of Montgomery reduction combining low products

properties.access_pattern: Reads 32-bit lanes from Vn/Vm, writes 64-bit lanes to Vd
Reads 32-bit lanes, performs read-modify-write on 64-bit accumulator Vd

evidence.reference: NIST FIPS 204: Module-Lattice-Based Digital Signature Standard
Arm Architecture Reference Manual for A-profile architecture (ARM DDI 0487I.a)
